mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ledger_entry (partner_id, ledger_type, change_type, amount, balance_after, related_document_type, related_document_id, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{partnerId}, #{ledgerType}, #{changeType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{relatedDocumentType}, #{relatedDocumentId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ledger_entry WHERE partner_id = #{partnerId}
